title: FLA import: symbol instance first-frame and loop-mode not decoded from CPicSymbol
description:
readCPicSymbolFields() in flash8-binary.ts reads (line 1502-1503):
    r.skip(2); // first frame
    r.skip(1); // loop mode / kind byte

These two fields are non-trivial for graphic symbols:
- firstFrame: which frame of the referenced symbol to display (0-based). Graphic symbols placed on a timeline always show a specific frame; the default is frame 1.
- loopMode / kind: 0=loop, 1=play-once, 2=single-frame (graphic); for sprites this is a different field. Flash uses this to control how a graphic symbol instance animates on the parent timeline.

The SWF spec encodes this via PlaceObject2/3 FirstFrame field and the clip depth behavior. When loopMode is 'single frame', only one frame of the symbol is ever shown — this is very common for reusing individual frames of a graphic symbol as static imagery.

Steps:
1. Add firstFrame and loopMode fields to Fla8Instance in flash8-binary.ts
2. Read them in readCPicSymbolFields() instead of skipping
3. Forward to the SymbolInstance model in flash8-import.ts
4. Wire firstFrame to PlaceObject2 FirstFrame field in compile.ts (SWF spec field already exists but currently unused for non-tween placements)
